podcast.title: Dominance in 1999
podcast.body: Youthful Latin pop, particularly by artists like Ricky Martin and Enrique Iglesias, was a dominant genre in 1999. "Youthful Latin pop from Ricky Martin and Enrique Iglesias."

podcast.title: Mainstream Crossover Moment (1999)
podcast.body: The release and Grammy success of Santana's "Supernatural" album in 1999 was a significant cultural event, effectively "captured the moment in 1999 when Latin pop was going mainstream," broadening its appeal beyond traditional Latin music markets. "It captured the moment in 1999 when Latin pop was going mainstream."
